propositions: remediation_mode and novelty_drop_active flags ship as False by default, leaving two shipped convergence mechanisms (plan-review rising floor and code-review region-gated floor) inert despite field evidence showing 18% of tickets need 4+ review rounds and 32% verdict instability on byte-identical plans.
Flipping both flags to True by default activates the cross-round convergence machinery across both plan-review and code-review gates, with novelty_drop_active shared between the two subsystems.
All documentation, tests, and comments claiming default-OFF or inert-by-default status for these flags and their floors must be updated to reflect default-ON behavior.
The code-review region-gated floor must proceed its evidence-gate check when novelty_drop_active defaults to True, not short-circuit.
completion_floor_active remains default False and is unaffected by this change.
